% Pattern: env/title/article. An environment titled Subfact is a fact, and a
% proof environment titled Another proof is a proof.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want subfact-1 statement/fact 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=subfact-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{subfact}{Subfact}
\begin{document}
\begin{subfact}\label{sf} Each tree is a graph. \end{subfact}
\begin{proof}[Another proof of Subfact~\ref{sf}] A tree is a connected graph. \end{proof}
\end{document}
